statement_summary: FERC primary and alternate security contacts, coordinator, and OT security lead designated in writing
Risk assessment every July and after major changes; serves as the Security Assessment
Risk acceptance authority; gate risks never accepted at High
Proportionate discipline; good-faith reporting protected
Vendor security terms (MFA, 24-hour incident notice, data use); annual SOC 2 review
Annual independent assessment
5-year retention of security records; 12.10 reports kept as permanent project records
Annual July review of policies, OT procedures, asset criticality, and the Section 9 screen
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Change form for every HPCDMS change; Owner approval for any new remote or command path
Named accounts; shared local HMI sign-in only as a recorded exception
View-only remote access by default; remote commands only for alarm response or with approval
MFA for all remote access and administrator logins
One remote access path; no always-on vendor connection; integrator sessions approved and watched; session alerts
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 3.3.3; Table 9.3a remote and third-party access, voluntary)

statement_summary: No office access to the control network; OT-only engineering laptop; no browsing on the HMI PC
Termination checklist incl. shared OT passwords, keys, and gate codes by the last day
Weekly remote session review; quarterly account reconciliation
Panels, hoist house, and data logger cabinet locked; yearly key inventory; locks changed for unreturned keys
14-character unique passwords; defaults changed before connection; shared OT passwords changed on departure
Company systems for company work; HMI PC for plant operation only
No company information in personal accounts or public AI chatbots
Operational security; report unusual questions, photography, or drones
Only the company OT USB drive on OT equipment
Security training at hire and yearly (physical and cyber)
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed policy acknowledgment
Runbook for unauthorized access to gate and unit controls kept and printed
Local control of gates and units before any investigation
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a intrusion detection and response, voluntary)

statement_summary: Report within 15 minutes for gates, units, instruments; 1 hour otherwise
Security incidents and gate misoperation reported to the Regional Engineer, preferably within 72 hours; written report as directed
Suspicious activity and incidents to the FERC Regional Office within about one working day; HSIN report
EAP activation; sheriff and county emergency management in parallel; downstream weir operator; recreation closure notice
Other notices per the P08 matrix
Log every incident; preserve evidence before it rolls over
Ransom only with Owner, insurer, and counsel approval and an OFAC check
Vendor incident notice within 24 hours logged and handled
Annual tabletop; agencies at least every other year; may combine with the EAP readiness test
Lessons learned within 30 days
Three classification levels; CEII-type information is Restricted
CEII handling; FERC marking; named sharing only, never by open link
Restricted data only in approved locations; laptops encrypted
OT inventory and office and SaaS list updated with every change
Five security questions before any new tool, feature, trial, or AI add-on
Approved AI tools only; no Restricted data in public chatbots; no AI output to the control system
One encrypted, scanned OT USB drive
OT copies after every change and quarterly on 2 encrypted drives; yearly restore test
Wipe or certified destruction with records
Permanent project records and security record retention
